'''John Martin Bland''' (born 6 March 1947), known as '''Martin Bland''', is a British [[statistician]]. He has been professor of [[health statistics]] at the [[University of York]] since 2003.<ref name="ISI">[http://hcr3.isiknowledge.com/author.cgi?id=6022 Bland, J. Martin] at [[ISIHighlyCited.com]]. Retrieved 2011-01-20.</ref> Bland is known for his work on medical measurement, particularly methodology for method comparison studies such as the [[Bland–Altman plot]].

Bland was born in [[Stockport]] and obtained a BSc, MSc and diploma from [[Imperial College, London]], followed by a PhD in epidemiology from the [[University of London]]. Between 1976 and 2003 he worked at [[St. George's Hospital Medical School]], [[University of London]].<ref name="ISI"/>
